newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus denies Northwest purchase close.
newsitem.headline: Airbus denies Northwest purchase close.

text.p: Airbus Industrie denied on Monday a published report that it was close to clinching a major deal with Northwest Airlines Corp for the purchase of 50 Airbus planes.
"We are in talks with them as with many other companies," said an Airbus spokesman.
The Wall Street Journal reported that Northwest was close to a deal with Airbus Industrie for the purchase of 50 planes with a list price value of $2 billion.

The newspaper said that Northwest was in the later stage of negotiations to order 50 narrow-body 125 seat A319s with options on up to 100 more of the jet. If all options were excercised, the Northwest order would have a list price of about $6 billion, the newspaper said.
